items.author: Musk
items.text: Tesla (TSLA) crashes 12%, sheds $140B as Elon Musk’s ‘just trust me’ doesn’t hold anymore
items.summary_cn: 特斯拉单日暴跌12%，市值蒸发1400亿美元，市场对马斯克'相信我'式的AI/自动驾驶承诺彻底失信。

items.author: Musk
items.summary_cn: 特斯拉单日暴跌14%，马斯克身家蒸发180亿美元，市场对Robotaxi/Optimus等AI叙事信心受挫。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Preaches Patience On Robotaxi, Optimus Rollout. Tesla Stock Plummets.
items.summary_cn: 马斯克呼吁对Robotaxi和Optimus机器人量产保持耐心，但特斯拉股价随即大跌，'信任溢价'正在消退。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Will SpaceX buy Tesla? Elon Musk is not revealing his plans
items.summary_cn: 马斯克被问及SpaceX是否会收购特斯拉但拒绝透露计划，市场猜测其商业帝国整合可能性，间接关联kcn持有的SpaceX相关仓位。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Suddenly, as His Empire Crumbles, Elon Musk Admits He Made a Huge Mistake With DOGE
items.summary_cn: 马斯克罕见承认DOGE（政府效率部门）犯了'巨大错误'，与其加密同名代币及加密板块情绪相关。

This is done in order to RESHORE Generic Pharmaceutical Production into America, with a penalty to those Companies that decide not to build Plant and Equipment within the stated period of time given to them.
